savicLabs.config.title: SavicLabs
savicLabs.config.baseUrl.description: Primary API endpoint URL. Used as fallback when endpoints array is empty.
savicLabs.config.endpoints.description: Array of API endpoint URLs for multi-server setups. Models are aggregated from all endpoints with source labels. Example: ["http://127.0.0.1:18080/v1", "http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1"]
savicLabs.config.maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens per response. Set to 0 for unlimited (API default).
savicLabs.config.requestTimeoutMs.descri: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds. Increase for large models that take time to load (default: 120000 = 2 minutes).
savicLabs.config.modelIdOverrides.descri: Map VS Code model IDs to different API model IDs. Useful for proxies or custom model names.
savicLabs.config.experimental.stabilizeT: **Experimental**: Pre-activate tools with a no-op call to improve context-cache hit rates.
savicLabs.config.visionModel.description: VS Code language model ID to use for describing images (vision proxy). Leave empty for auto-detection. Example: `copilot/gpt-4o`.
savicLabs.config.visionPrompt.descriptio: Prompt template sent to the vision describer model. Use `{imageCount}` as a placeholder for the number of images.
savicLabs.config.debugMode.minimal.label: Minimal
savicLabs.config.debugMode.verbose.label: Verbose
savicLabs.config.debugMode.metadata.desc: Adds request metadata, token counts, and classification info.
savicLabs.config.debugMode.verbose.descr: Full request/response dumps written to disk. Use for debugging.
savicLabs.walkthrough.title: Get Started with SavicLabs
savicLabs.walkthrough.description: Connect your local llama.cpp models to Copilot Chat.
savicLabs.walkthrough.setEndpoint.title: Configure Your Endpoint
savicLabs.walkthrough.setEndpoint.descri: Set the URL of your llama.cpp or OpenAI-compatible API server.
savicLabs.walkthrough.showModels.title: Select a Model
savicLabs.walkthrough.showModels.descrip: Your local models appear in the Copilot Chat model picker. Select one to start chatting.
